assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square invitation cover for a budget-conscious pagan woodland Halloween house party. Create a beautiful cinematic illustrated night forest: a large pale moon above interlaced bare oak branches, deep moss green shadows, three rich orange pumpkins on the forest edge, small warm amber lights, subtle oxblood leaves, a distant mysterious but welcoming tree-spirit silhouette with branch antlers. The mood is enchanted, eerie, adult and intimate, not gory, not kitschy. A small fairy ring of mushrooms in the foreground. Artful folk-tale print texture and rich atmospheric depth. Composition: striking at phone thumbnail size, moon upper center, clean dark upper area, no text, no logos, no candles or visible flames. This is an evocative artwork, not a promised photograph of the actual venue.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: guest costume inspiration sheet for a pagan woodland Halloween house party. Create a beautifully art-directed illustrated fashion sheet with six different full-body adults in an evenly spaced 3 by 2 grid on pale warm parchment, tasteful hand-painted fashion illustration. All looks should be achievable with thrifted ordinary clothes plus one homemade accessory, not expensive fantasy armor. Diverse adult models, varied body types and genders, comfortable closed shoes. Upper row: a forest god wearing a brown shirt and trousers with small soft twig antlers and leaf collar; a harvest goddess wearing burgundy dress with apple and golden leaf crown; a moon spirit in silver-grey layered clothes with crescent pendant and subtle silver makeup. Lower row: a mushroom sprite in cream clothes and soft russet mushroom beret; a dark woodland witch in black clothes and short moss-green shawl with leaf brooch; a faun in brown trousers, boots and small curved horns, simple green scarf. Restrained moss green, oxblood, copper, charcoal, parchment palette. Grounded adult party looks; no weapons, no long trailing hems, no giant wings, no nudity, no elaborate sacred regalia. Small clear labels exactly: 'FOREST GOD', 'HARVEST GODDESS', 'MOON SPIRIT', 'MUSHROOM SPRITE', 'WOODLAND WITCH', 'FAUN'. Header exactly 'COME AS SOMETHING THE FOREST REMEMBERS'.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape three-panel room moodboard for a modest Halloween house party, believable small apartment scale and inexpensive DIY, editorial interior illustration with warm cinematic lighting. Three equal panels labeled exactly 'THE OCTOBER GROVE', 'THE HOLLOW', 'THE MOON WELL'. Panel one small ordinary living room: couch aimed toward a modest TV displaying silent forest imagery, low coffee table with four seats, clear dark floor, one restrained forest corner with two upright secured branches, 3 pumpkins and moss in trays, large pale paper moon on wall, sparse amber fairy lights, leaves attached to wall. Panel two small bedroom converted for dancing: open clear floor, one black fabric backdrop at rear, low red and muted violet uplighting, modest waist-high DJ table with laptop and controller, a lightweight twig-and-paper woodland guardian bust behind it, sparse root silhouettes. No bed visible, no raised platform, no real cave build, no overhead branches. Panel three simple bathroom: usable sink and mirror, moon decal on top corner, two battery LED votives on a dry shelf and short ivy trim away from faucet, ordinary warm practical lighting still on. Shared moss green, oxblood, charcoal, amber and moon silver palette. No people, no flame, no haze, no lasers, no sprawling mansion, no full floor moss, no luxury installations. Clearly evocative illustrated concepts rather than measured plans.
